notes.content:

notes.title: Boss Ride
notes.content:
🎉 Boss Ride Update – New Content and Improvements! 🎮    
      🚀 Pilots, get ready! The Boss Ride mode in Void Phantom has been revamped to deliver a more intense and thrilling experience.    
        🔥 New and Updated Content          🤖 Enhanced AI: Bosses are now more strategic and unpredictable.      👑 +3 Unique New Bosses: Face legendary enemies available only in Boss Ride mode.      ✨ Updated effects and sound: Dive into more epic and visually stunning battles.        🏆 New Achievements          +2 Achievements to unlock! Push your limits and complete epic challenges.        🔧 Improvements and Fixes          Enhanced controls for smoother gameplay.      Updated visuals for a superior experience.      Fixed various bugs reported by the community.            
      Dive into action and challenge the new bosses! Available now on Void Phantom.
